evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: "Push harder", "accelerate your career faster than anywhere else", "eager to innovate and continuously improve data processes" signal speed and ambition; "data integrity", "root cause analysis", "testing frameworks", "version control" signal rigour is also required — balanced but velocity-forward.
evidence.domain_risk: "Community of over 70 million users", "marketing analytics", "rewarding our community for engaging with our advertisers' products" — errors in marketing analytics affect advertiser reporting and campaign optimisation; "proactively monitor data integrity, identify issues, and perform root cause analysis" signals existing data quality failures have been costly.
evidence.jd_authorship: "Performance-optimised data models using SQL and dbt", "version control, testing, and continuous integration", "data validation, testing, and reporting processes" are precise technical signals; "passionate about transforming data into actionable insights", "a detail-oriented problem-solver who excels in a collaborative environment", "eager to innovate" are personality descriptors with zero technical specificity — mixed authorship (technical lead wrote requirements; founders/marketing wrote overview and preferred skills).
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: "Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models", "automate and streamline data validation", "train business users on the data platform" suggest building out a maturing data function; "self-service analytics" as a goal (not current state) confirms mid-maturity with greenfield scope.
evidence.data_team_maturity: "Core member of our analytics team", "take ownership of data analysis for a designated domain" suggest a small analytics team (likely 3–6 people) where each person owns a domain end-to-end; "train business users on utilising the data platform" implies business users are not yet self-sufficient — mid-maturity data function.
evidence.collaboration_width: "Collaborating closely with Product Analysts, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to meet their analytical and reporting needs", "train business users on utilising the data platform and data visualisation tools effectively" — four distinct interfaces: Product Analysts, Data Scientists, Business Stakeholders, and business users.
evidence.urgency: No explicit urgency language. However "push harder", "accelerate faster than anywhere else", "Europe's #3 fastest-growing company" signal a high-urgency culture where ramp speed is implicitly valued.
